label: Frozen-model evaluation
claim: Saved full-feature XGBoost was evaluated on the reconstructed held-out sample without fitting.
limitation: This site reads the recorded result; it does not rerun the model or download the raw data.

label: Resolved sample and split
claim: Sampling and ordered split were reconstructed for the frozen evaluation.
limitation: Resolved accepted loans only; boundary months overlap.

label: Default-filling diagnostic
claim: Replacing 40 fields with training defaults lowers ranking metrics.
limitation: Not an exact browser/API simulation; collected fields retain dataset values and missingness.

label: Paired AUC comparisons
claim: Only the two combined-XGBoost intervals exclude zero.
limitation: Baselines and intervals were not freshly reproduced; some comparisons change both features and estimator.

label: EDA and cohort tables
claim: Issue-year drift, missingness and engineered-feature patterns informed later choices.
limitation: Full-sample outcome-labelled EDA exposed holdout patterns; charts are descriptive.

label: Seven-model test evaluation
claim: Saved table compares ranking, probability errors and lift.
limitation: Only XGBoost frozen metrics were reproduced later.

label: Search space and choice
claim: 18 candidates and 3 temporal folds selected the saved configuration.
limitation: One finite search does not establish an optimal model.

label: Permutation importance
claim: Term, FICO midpoint and loan-to-income have the largest saved PR-AUC drops.
limitation: Not causal, not local explanations, and not a fairness test.

label: Validation-chosen threshold
claim: Calibrated XGBoost achieved 66.1% test recall at the validation-selected cutoff.
limitation: The target was at least 70% on validation, not an approved business policy.

label: Loss and pricing back-test
claim: Training net LGD and fixed cost assumptions generate illustrative prices.
limitation: Lifetime loss and annual-looking rates are not financially consistent cash-flow pricing.

label: Training implementation
claim: Named leakage fields are excluded and preprocessing is fitted within train/CV pipelines.
limitation: Does not verify all source-field snapshot timing or remove analyst leakage from EDA.

label: Serving input and response
claim: Default filling, recomputed loan-to-income, PD, policy, price and repayment are separate stages.
limitation: A valid model invocation is not a validated reduced-input product.

label: API rules
claim: Finite values, ranges and category whitelists are checked.
limitation: Omitted required keys still default; browser step sizes are not enforced by the API.

label: Saved artifact inspection
claim: 56 conceptual features expand to 124 columns; application_type has no saved-tree split.
limitation: Recorded local artifact inspection; no claim of new training or a new environment audit.

label: Funding and margin
claim: Funding cost is 4%; operating margin is 2.5%.
limitation: These are illustrative inputs, not observed costs.

label: Application-time timing
claim: Source names and code roles cannot prove when every bureau snapshot was captured.
limitation: An authoritative version-matched data dictionary and collection-time record are needed.

label: Raw field-screening record
claim: The notebook counts 151 columns but manually lists only the 64 loaded fields.
limitation: No complete raw header or authoritative dictionary is committed.

label: Fairness evaluation
claim: No completed protected-class, proxy or subgroup fairness audit is recorded.
limitation: Functional tests cannot establish fairness or lawful underwriting.

label: Next experiments
claim: Direct reduced-form evaluation, timing checks and a consistent cash-flow model are needed.
limitation: These are recommendations, not completed experiments.

label: Deployment history
claim: Recorded owner output reports dependency success and a memory-gate stop before activation.
limitation: The site has no VM access; recovery, hosted parity and renewal remain unconfirmed.
